# barebones3d.com

> Open-source repair tutorials, downloadable 3D CAD files, and reproduction engineering prints for obsolete OEM hardware.

Barebones 3D provides precision diagnostic guides and commercial-grade replacement components for discontinued automotive, appliance, and electromechanical assemblies. All designs feature pre-calibrated printer tolerance compensation (+0.15mm) and are verified 100% watertight 2-manifold solids.

## Licensing & Commercial Policy

- Open-source designs released under CC BY 4.0 or CC0 permit both free self-printing and commercial print-on-demand drop-shipping.
- Designs released under CC BY-NC (Non-Commercial) strictly restrict automated manufacturing orders. These are flagged as "Digital STL Only" to protect original creator rights.
- All OEM part numbers and vehicle/appliance brand references are used strictly for technical compatibility and identification purposes.

# Audi A4 / A5 / Q5 MMI Central Control Volume Knob Internal D-Shaft (OEM #8K0898192A)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `8K0898192A`
- **Engineering Material:** High-Temp Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 30 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [8K0898192A.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/audi-mmi-volume-knob-shaft-8k0898192a.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Audi%20A4%20%2F%20A5%20%2F%20Q5%20MMI%20Central%20Control%20Volume%20Knob%20Internal%20D-Shaft%20OEM%208K0898192A&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Plastic Trim Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Plastic%20Trim%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: MMI console surround pry tool *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Extract Center Console MMI Control Panel

Pry the aluminum/wood center console trim with a nylon pry tool to expose the volume rotary encoder.

![Original broken plastic Audi A4 / A5 / Q5 MMI Central Control Volume Knob Internal D-Shaft (OEM #8K0898192A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed High-Temp Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/8k0898192a-audi-mmi-volume-knob-shaft-8k0898192a-step-1.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why did the volume knob spin freely?
**A:** The internal hollow plastic D-shaft fractures under torsional shear when pressed downward to mute.

# BMW 3-Series (E90 / E91 / E92) In-Dash Retractable Cup Holder Internal Catch & Pinion (OEM #51459173463)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `51459173463`
- **Engineering Material:** Automotive ASA (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 20 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [51459173463.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/bmw-3-series-e90-e91-e92-in-dash-retractable-cup-holder-internal-catch-pinion-51459173463.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=BMW%20E90%20dash%20cup%20holder%20assembly%20replacement%20driver%20passenger&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Phillips #1 Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Phillips%20%231%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove dash cartridge mounting screws *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Plastic Trim Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Plastic%20Trim%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Pry loose dash decorative wood/aluminum strip *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Pry Passenger Dash Trim Strip

Gently unclip the horizontal passenger dashboard trim bezel to expose the two cupholder faceplate screws.

![Original broken plastic BMW 3-Series (E90 / E91 / E92) In-Dash Retractable Cup Holder Internal Catch & Pinion (OEM #51459173463) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/51459173463-bmw-3-series-e90-e91-e92-in-dash-retractable-cup-holder-internal-catch-pinion-51459173463-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Extract Cupholder Cartridge

Remove the two PH1 screws and slide the entire rectangular cassette forward out of the dashboard housing.

![Original broken plastic BMW 3-Series (E90 / E91 / E92) In-Dash Retractable Cup Holder Internal Catch & Pinion (OEM #51459173463) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/51459173463-bmw-3-series-e90-e91-e92-in-dash-retractable-cup-holder-internal-catch-pinion-51459173463-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Replace Sheared Heart-Cam Pawl

Pop open the cassette side plate and replace the broken spring-loaded heart-cam latch and pinion.

![Original broken plastic BMW 3-Series (E90 / E91 / E92) In-Dash Retractable Cup Holder Internal Catch & Pinion (OEM #51459173463) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/51459173463-bmw-3-series-e90-e91-e92-in-dash-retractable-cup-holder-internal-catch-pinion-51459173463-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Reassemble & Test Push-Push Latch

Snap side plate shut, slide cassette back into dashboard cavity, tighten screws, and reinstall dash trim.

![Original broken plastic BMW 3-Series (E90 / E91 / E92) In-Dash Retractable Cup Holder Internal Catch & Pinion (OEM #51459173463) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/51459173463-bmw-3-series-e90-e91-e92-in-dash-retractable-cup-holder-internal-catch-pinion-51459173463-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why did the cup holder fail to pop out?
**A:** The factory molded heart-cam follower tooth wears down or shears off, failing to catch the retraction detent.

#### Q: Is driver side and passenger side identical?
**A:** The internal latch pawl is universally mirrored, fitting both left and right dashboard cassettes.

# Black & Decker String Trimmer Replacement Spool Cap Cover (OEM #90530948)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `90530948`
- **Engineering Material:** PETG Heavy Duty (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Beginner
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 5 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)

- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Black%20Decker%20string%20trimmer%20spool%20cap%20replacement%2090530948&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Flathead Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Flathead%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Depress locking tabs on worn spool head *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Depress Side Release Tabs

Squeeze the two dual release tabs on the sides of the spool housing to pop off the worn or ground-down cap cover.

![Original broken plastic Black & Decker String Trimmer Replacement Spool Cap Cover (OEM #90530948) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/90530948-black-decker-trimmer-replacement-spool-cap-90530948-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Inspect Internal Feed Spring

Ensure the internal steel compression spring is seated properly inside the central spindle channel.

![Original broken plastic Black & Decker String Trimmer Replacement Spool Cap Cover (OEM #90530948) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/90530948-black-decker-trimmer-replacement-spool-cap-90530948-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Snap Replacement Cap On

Press the replacement cap down over the string spool until both side retention claws click solidly into place.

![Original broken plastic Black & Decker String Trimmer Replacement Spool Cap Cover (OEM #90530948) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/90530948-black-decker-trimmer-replacement-spool-cap-90530948-step-3.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why is this marked as Commodity Affiliate?
**A:** Spool caps wear down from constant ground friction. Mass-produced 4-packs and 6-packs with included replacement springs are available on Amazon for $8–$11, making custom 3D printing uneconomical.

# Bosch / Siemens Washing Machine Drain Pump Filter Repair Grip (OEM #00605010)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `00605010`
- **Engineering Material:** PETG Heavy Duty (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 20 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [00605010.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/bosch-washing-machine-drain-filter-handle-00605010.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Bosch%20washing%20machine%20drain%20pump%20filter%20replacement%2000605010%20605010&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Shallow Tray & Old Towel](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Shallow%20Tray%20Old%20Towel&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Catch remaining pump water *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Small Channel Lock Pliers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Small%20Channel%20Lock%20Pliers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Twist broken filter core *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[M4x20mm Stainless Screw (Optional)](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=M4x20mm%20Stainless%20Screw%20Optional&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Reinforced mechanical anchor *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Disconnect Power & Open Service Flap

Unplug washing machine. Place towels beneath the lower right circular service flap and flip it downward.

![Original broken plastic Bosch / Siemens Washing Machine Drain Pump Filter Repair Grip (OEM #00605010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/00605010-bosch-washing-machine-drain-filter-handle-00605010-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Drain Water via Small Bleed Hose

Pull out the small emergency rubber drain hose, remove the plug into your shallow tray, and let all stagnant water drain out.

![Original broken plastic Bosch / Siemens Washing Machine Drain Pump Filter Repair Grip (OEM #00605010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/00605010-bosch-washing-machine-drain-filter-handle-00605010-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Slide Barebones 3D Heavy-Duty Handle Over Filter Core

Slide the contoured repair cap over the sheared OEM filter stub. The dual internal rib channels lock firmly into the OEM filter ribs, providing 3x the rotational torque.

![Original broken plastic Bosch / Siemens Washing Machine Drain Pump Filter Repair Grip (OEM #00605010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/00605010-bosch-washing-machine-drain-filter-handle-00605010-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Unscrew Counter-Clockwise and Clear Debris

Grip the ergonomic textured handle and turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees. Remove coins, lint, or hairpins from the impeller cavity, rinse the filter, and screw back into place.

![Original broken plastic Bosch / Siemens Washing Machine Drain Pump Filter Repair Grip (OEM #00605010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/00605010-bosch-washing-machine-drain-filter-handle-00605010-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why do washing machine filter handles snap off?
**A:** Lint, hair, and hard water scale bind the rubber seal against the plastic pump housing. When users attempt to force it open with pliers, the thin center web shears off.

#### Q: Does this replace the whole filter or just the handle?
**A:** This is a slip-on mechanical sleeve that interlocks with the surviving filter core, saving you from purchasing an expensive replacement pump assembly.

# Bose QuietComfort 35 (QC35 I & II) Swivel Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #QC35-HINGE-ASSY)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `QC35-HINGE-ASSY`
- **Engineering Material:** Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 25 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $19.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [QC35-HINGE-ASSY.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/bose-qc35-swivel-hinge-bracket-qc35-hinge-assy.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Bose%20QC35%20replacement%20hinge%20swivel%20bracket&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[PH00 Precision Phillips Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=PH00%20Precision%20Phillips%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Back out internal micro-screws securing inner headphone pivot covers *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Nylon Spudger Pry Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Nylon%20Spudger%20Pry%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Unsnap headband trim rings without marring the finish *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Fine Curved Tweezers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Fine%20Curved%20Tweezers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Route ultra-thin audio wires through the replacement hinge tunnel *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Ear Pad and Inner Dust Scrim Removal

Grip the edge of the leatherette ear cushion and pull firmly inward to disengage the eight perimeter plastic locking tabs. Peel back the foam inner scrim to inspect the swivel joint wiring channel.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 (QC35 I & II) Swivel Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #QC35-HINGE-ASSY) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/qc35-hinge-assy-bose-qc35-swivel-hinge-bracket-qc35-hinge-assy-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Headband Swivel Bracket Screws Extraction

Locate the two PH00 screws securing the plastic interior hinge cover plate. Back them out with your precision driver and set them on a magnetic mat. Pry the cosmetic outer shell free with a spudger.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 (QC35 I & II) Swivel Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #QC35-HINGE-ASSY) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/qc35-hinge-assy-bose-qc35-swivel-hinge-bracket-qc35-hinge-assy-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Broken Swivel Arm Demounting and Wiring Clearance

Carefully tilt the cracked hinge collar off the steel headband slider pin. Slide the delicate audio cable through the hinge slot with tweezers. Take care not to pinch the braided shield or pull solder joints loose from the ear-cup driver board.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 (QC35 I & II) Swivel Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #QC35-HINGE-ASSY) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/qc35-hinge-assy-bose-qc35-swivel-hinge-bracket-qc35-hinge-assy-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: PA12 Replacement Hinge Seat and Mechanical Closure

Thread the audio harness through the open slot of the Barebones 3D PA12 replacement swivel arm. Snap the arm over the metal pivot pin, align the cosmetic backplate, and torque the two PH00 screws until snug. Re-clip the ear cushions until you hear the eight distinct clicks.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 (QC35 I & II) Swivel Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #QC35-HINGE-ASSY) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/qc35-hinge-assy-bose-qc35-swivel-hinge-bracket-qc35-hinge-assy-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Will Bose repair just the plastic hinge collar?
**A:** No. Bose considers the hinge non-serviceable and will only offer an out-of-warranty replacement unit for $150 to $200+, rendering this $19 repair an 88% cost savings.

#### Q: Why is Nylon PA12 necessary instead of PLA or resin?
**A:** The swivel hinge undergoes continuous torsional twisting and tension every time the headphones are flexed onto the listener's head. PLA creeps and fractures along layer lines, while SLS Nylon PA12 provides isotropic mechanical strength.

# Bose QuietComfort 35 / 45 Headband Swivel Hinge Joint Replacement (OEM #759944-0010)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `759944-0010`
- **Engineering Material:** Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 30 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $20.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [759944-0010.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/bose-quietcomfort-35-45-headband-swivel-hinge-joint-replacement-759944-0010.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Bose%20QC35%20QC45%20replacement%20headband%20swivel%20hinge%20repair%20parts&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Torx T6 Precision Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Torx%20T6%20Precision%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove micro hinge pivot clamp screws *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Fine Curved Tweezers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Fine%20Curved%20Tweezers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Guide delicate audio ribbon wiring through hinge slot *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Remove Inner Hinge Cover Screws

Unscrew the two Torx T6 micro screws on the inner headband hinge clamp to expose audio wiring.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 / 45 Headband Swivel Hinge Joint Replacement (OEM #759944-0010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/759944-0010-bose-quietcomfort-35-45-headband-swivel-hinge-joint-replacement-759944-0010-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Unhook Swivel Ear-Cup Arm

Carefully slide the cracked outer swivel knuckle off the steel headband slider arm without pinching the wire.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 / 45 Headband Swivel Hinge Joint Replacement (OEM #759944-0010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/759944-0010-bose-quietcomfort-35-45-headband-swivel-hinge-joint-replacement-759944-0010-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Thread Audio Wire Through New Hinge

Using tweezers, guide the audio wire harness safely through the internal slot of the Nylon PA12 hinge.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 / 45 Headband Swivel Hinge Joint Replacement (OEM #759944-0010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/759944-0010-bose-quietcomfort-35-45-headband-swivel-hinge-joint-replacement-759944-0010-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Snap Hinge Knuckle & Tighten Screws

Seat the hinge knuckle into the slider track and torque the two T6 screws snugly until flush.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 / 45 Headband Swivel Hinge Joint Replacement (OEM #759944-0010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/759944-0010-bose-quietcomfort-35-45-headband-swivel-hinge-joint-replacement-759944-0010-step-4.webp)

### Step 5: Verify Fold & Audio Continuity

Fold earcup 90 degrees flat into storage orientation and power on headset to verify stereo audio channels.

![Original broken plastic Bose QuietComfort 35 / 45 Headband Swivel Hinge Joint Replacement (OEM #759944-0010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/759944-0010-bose-quietcomfort-35-45-headband-swivel-hinge-joint-replacement-759944-0010-step-5.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Do I need to desolder any audio wires?
**A:** No. The hinge is engineered with a slotted wire passthrough channel that eliminates desoldering completely.

#### Q: Why is SLS Nylon PA12 required instead of resin?
**A:** Resin becomes brittle and snaps under the torsional flexing of the headband. Nylon PA12 provides flex fatigue resistance.

# DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 12-Inch Miter Saw High-Flow Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N087403)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `N087403`
- **Engineering Material:** PETG Heavy Duty (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 15 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $25.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [N087403.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/dewalt-dws779-dws780-12-inch-miter-saw-high-flow-dust-extraction-chute-n087403.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=DeWalt%20DWS780%20miter%20saw%20upgraded%20dust%20collection%20chute%20adapter&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Unbolt OEM Rubber Dust Funnel

Remove two T20 Torx screws securing the factory rubber dust funnel to the rear aluminum swing arm.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 12-Inch Miter Saw High-Flow Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N087403) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n087403-dewalt-dws779-dws780-12-inch-miter-saw-high-flow-dust-extraction-chute-n087403-step-1.webp)

Brush away compacted sawdust and pitch resin from the blade guard rear exhaust trajectory.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 12-Inch Miter Saw High-Flow Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N087403) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n087403-dewalt-dws779-dws780-12-inch-miter-saw-high-flow-dust-extraction-chute-n087403-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Mount Enlarged Throat PETG Chute

Position the wide-mouth heavy-duty PETG collector onto the pivot boss and torque screws to 3 Nm.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 12-Inch Miter Saw High-Flow Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N087403) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n087403-dewalt-dws779-dws780-12-inch-miter-saw-high-flow-dust-extraction-chute-n087403-step-3.webp)

Perform a complete bevel and slide pass to verify zero blade clearance interference, then connect shop vac.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 12-Inch Miter Saw High-Flow Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N087403) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n087403-dewalt-dws779-dws780-12-inch-miter-saw-high-flow-dust-extraction-chute-n087403-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: How much does this improve dust collection efficiency?
**A:** The oversized aerodynamic throat captures over 85% of sawdust compared to under 35% with the OEM rubber chute.

#### Q: Will this collide with the saw blade at full 45-degree bevel?
**A:** No. The model includes an engineered bevel relief notch that preserves full 49-degree dual-bevel travel.

# DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 Miter Saw High-Efficiency Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N447388)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `N447388`
- **Engineering Material:** PETG Heavy Duty (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 15 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $28.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [N447388.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/dewalt-dws779-dws780-dust-extraction-chute-n447388.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=DeWalt%20DWS779%20DWS780%20miter%20saw%20dust%20chute%20deflector&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[T25 Torx Driver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=T25%20Torx%20Driver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove the OEM rubber chute retaining screws on saw blade casting *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Shop Vacuum with Utility Brush](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Shop%20Vacuum%20with%20Utility%20Brush&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Clean out packed wood chips and resin from aluminum blade housing channel *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Blade Guard Retraction and OEM Rubber Flap Removal

Disconnect power to the miter saw. Raise the saw head to maximum height and lock the bevel angle at 0°. Locate the two T25 Torx screws securing the factory stock black rubber dust funnel behind the blade guard casting and extract them.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 Miter Saw High-Efficiency Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N447388) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n447388-dewalt-dws779-dws780-dust-extraction-chute-n447388-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Casting Channel Debris Clearance

Vacuum out all packed sawdust and sticky pitch buildup along the miter saw intake manifold. Ensure the seating face of the aluminum casting is flat so the replacement chute seals flush against negative vacuum pressure.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 Miter Saw High-Efficiency Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N447388) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n447388-dewalt-dws779-dws780-dust-extraction-chute-n447388-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Aerodynamic PETG Deflector Chute Positioning

Slide the Barebones 3D PETG chute down over the saw arm neck. The dual contoured intake scoops must drop directly behind the kerf line of the 12-inch blade without making contact with the moving blade guard linkage.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 Miter Saw High-Efficiency Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N447388) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n447388-dewalt-dws779-dws780-dust-extraction-chute-n447388-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Fastener Re-Torque and Bevel Clearance Validation

Re-install the two factory T25 Torx screws through the chute's reinforced mounting eyelets. Hand tighten securely without stripping into the aluminum threads. Slowly pivot the saw through its entire 47° left and right bevel sweep to confirm zero collision.

![Original broken plastic DeWalt DWS779 / DWS780 Miter Saw High-Efficiency Dust Extraction Chute (OEM #N447388) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/n447388-dewalt-dws779-dws780-dust-extraction-chute-n447388-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why does the factory DeWalt dust chute perform so poorly?
**A:** The stock rubber chute sits over 3 inches back from the blade kerf and flexes away under suction, catching less than 40% of waste stream particles. This rigid, contoured scoop captures upward of 90%.

#### Q: Will this part melt from blade friction or hot carbide teeth?
**A:** No. The chute is printed in industrial PETG with a 75°C+ heat deflection temperature and is engineered with clearance to maintain an intentional 8mm air gap away from high-speed carbide tooth orbit.

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why do factory Dyson triggers always fail?
**A:** The OEM trigger features a 0.8mm plastic load-bearing rib that experiences cyclic fatigue with every pull.

#### Q: How is the 3D printed model reinforced?
**A:** Our model fills the hollow structural cavity to 2.4mm solid cross-section in indestructible SLS Nylon PA12.

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Battery and Bin Release

Press the red lever to release and slide off the clear dust bin. Unscrew the three Torx/Phillips screws securing the battery pack (one on the rear handle spine, two on the base) and drop the battery out.

![Original broken plastic Dyson V10 / V11 Cordless Vacuum Reinforced Trigger Switch Assembly (OEM #970050-01) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/970050-01-dyson-v10-v11-cordless-vacuum-reinforced-trigger-switch-970050-01-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Motor Body Clamshell Separation

Using a long-shank T8 Torx driver, extract the five perimeter screws securing the main handle halves. Disconnect the electrical wire harness leading to the LCD/trigger microswitch board and separate the housing.

![Original broken plastic Dyson V10 / V11 Cordless Vacuum Reinforced Trigger Switch Assembly (OEM #970050-01) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/970050-01-dyson-v10-v11-cordless-vacuum-reinforced-trigger-switch-970050-01-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Broken Trigger Lever Extraction

Locate the red trigger mechanism. The common failure point is the microscopic internal plastic structural rib that contacts the electronic microswitch. Slide the broken trigger out of its retention track along with the small coil spring.

![Original broken plastic Dyson V10 / V11 Cordless Vacuum Reinforced Trigger Switch Assembly (OEM #970050-01) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/970050-01-dyson-v10-v11-cordless-vacuum-reinforced-trigger-switch-970050-01-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Reinforced Trigger Installation and Clamshell Assembly

Position the heavy-duty reinforced trigger into the guide slot, making sure the return coil spring is seated over the guide pin. Re-align the handle clamshell, route the wiring away from pinch points, and re-torque the five T8 screws. Slide the battery pack into place and verify immediate motor response.

![Original broken plastic Dyson V10 / V11 Cordless Vacuum Reinforced Trigger Switch Assembly (OEM #970050-01) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/970050-01-dyson-v10-v11-cordless-vacuum-reinforced-trigger-switch-970050-01-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: What is the OEM hostage gouge on Dyson triggers?
**A:** Dyson refuses to sell the 2-gram plastic trigger switch by itself. Dyson service centers require purchasing the entire Main Body & Cyclone motor assembly for $99 to $149.

#### Q: Why monetize this part via affiliate link rather than print-on-demand?
**A:** Mass-produced injection-molded polycarbonate triggers bundled with the required deep-reach T8 Torx screwdriver sell on Amazon for under $10 with next-day shipping. Routing non-printer users to an affiliate link captures broader 24-hour cart cookies, while makers can print the open-source STL on demand.

# Ford F-150 / Expedition HVAC Blend Door Actuator Reduction Gear (OEM #DL3Z-19E616-A)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `DL3Z-19E616-A`
- **Engineering Material:** Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 50 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $22.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [DL3Z-19E616-A.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/ford-f-150-expedition-blend-door-actuator-gear-dl3z-19e616-a.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Ford%20F150%20blend%20door%20actuator%20gear%20DL3Z-19E616-A&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[5.5mm (7/32") Nut Driver & Flex Socket](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=5.5mm%207%2F32%20Nut%20Driver%20Flex%20Socket&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove the microscopic factory Ford actuator mounting screws behind dash cavity *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Non-Marring Trim Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Non-Marring%20Trim%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Pry dash decorative trim panels without marring vinyl grain *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[8mm Magnetic Socket](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=8mm%20Magnetic%20Socket&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove center console side bracket anchor bolts *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Center Stack Side Trim Release

Insert a non-marring pry bar into the lower seam of the center console trim panel on the passenger side. Pop the metal spring clips outward to reveal the lower HVAC plenum casing. Disconnect the auxiliary 12V socket harness.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Expedition HVAC Blend Door Actuator Reduction Gear (OEM #DL3Z-19E616-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/dl3z-19e616-a-ford-f-150-expedition-blend-door-actuator-gear-dl3z-19e616-a-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Actuator Extraction (5.5mm Fasteners)

Use a 5.5mm (7/32") flex socket to remove the two rear-facing screws holding the blend door actuator to the air distribution box. Clear the wiring loom clip from the actuator housing, unplug the electrical connector, and draw the unit down.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Expedition HVAC Blend Door Actuator Reduction Gear (OEM #DL3Z-19E616-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/dl3z-19e616-a-ford-f-150-expedition-blend-door-actuator-gear-dl3z-19e616-a-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Housing Tab Release and Stripped Gear Removal

Disengage the five perimeter locking tabs of the black plastic housing using a small flathead tool. Pry open the case. Pull the large output reduction gear off its metal axle pin. Observe the missing or sheared teeth that caused the classic Ford dashboard clicking sound.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Expedition HVAC Blend Door Actuator Reduction Gear (OEM #DL3Z-19E616-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/dl3z-19e616-a-ford-f-150-expedition-blend-door-actuator-gear-dl3z-19e616-a-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: PA12 Splined Gear Drop-In and HVAC Relearn

Seat the Barebones 3D PA12 replacement reduction gear onto the center steel axle. Re-mesh with the intermediate worm pinion, verifying clean concentric rotation. Snap the top case shut, rebolt with the 5.5mm fasteners, pull the HVAC fuse in the passenger kick panel for 60 seconds, and cycle ignition ON to initiate auto-calibration.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Expedition HVAC Blend Door Actuator Reduction Gear (OEM #DL3Z-19E616-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/dl3z-19e616-a-ford-f-150-expedition-blend-door-actuator-gear-dl3z-19e616-a-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: What causes the rapid clicking sound behind my F-150 radio?
**A:** When the HVAC door reaches physical travel limits, the motor continues to supply torque. The weak factory POM gear teeth shear off, causing the worm gear to skip rapidly across the stripped void.

#### Q: Do I have to remove the entire dash to fix this?
**A:** No. Dealership flat rate pays for complete dashboard drop, but with a 5.5mm flex-head ratchet, this sub-gear replacement can be completed through the passenger glovebox cavity in under an hour.

# Ford F-150 / Super Duty Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm Repair Kit (OEM #FL3Z-1651071-A)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `FL3Z-1651071-A`
- **Engineering Material:** Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 50 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [FL3Z-1651071-A.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/ford-f-150-super-duty-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-repair-kit-fl3z-1651071-a.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Ford%20F150%20sunroof%20track%20repair%20kit%20metal%20synthetic%20grease&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Torx T25 Precision Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Torx%20T25%20Precision%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Unbolt front and rear sunroof glass panel retaining shoulder screws *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Non-Marring Nylon Trim Pry Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Non-Marring%20Nylon%20Trim%20Pry%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Unclip side rubber accordion bellows without tearing silicone weatherstripping *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Long Reach Needle-Nose Pliers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Long%20Reach%20Needle-Nose%20Pliers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Extract shattered OEM plastic slider fragments from lower aluminum track channel *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Synthetic Fluoropolymer / Silicone Grease](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Synthetic%20Fluoropolymer%20%2F%20Silicone%20Grease&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Coat sliding surfaces and aluminum channels to prevent friction wear *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Unclip Interior Rubber Accordion Bellows

Lower the sunshade fully and place the sunroof into partial vent position if operational. Working from the vehicle interior, wedge a non-marring nylon pry tool beneath the top lip of the rubber accordion boot on each side of the moving glass panel. Carefully peel down the three retaining push-tabs to expose the internal metal glass cradle and mounting hardware.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm Repair Kit (OEM #FL3Z-1651071-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-1651071-a-ford-f-150-super-duty-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-repair-kit-fl3z-1651071-a-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Remove Torx T25 Fasteners and Lift Glass Panel

Using a magnetic Torx T25 driver, remove the two forward and two rear shoulder screws securing the glass bracket to the mechanical slider arms. Support the glass center with one hand while backing out the final fastener. Lift the glass panel straight up and out through the roof aperture and place it onto a clean, padded surface.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm Repair Kit (OEM #FL3Z-1651071-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-1651071-a-ford-f-150-super-duty-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-repair-kit-fl3z-1651071-a-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Clear Shattered OEM Plastic Debris from Track Channels

Inspect the extruded aluminum guide rails for broken fragments of the brittle OEM lift arms. Using long reach needle-nose pliers, extract all sheared pivot ears, guide teeth, and retaining clips from the cable carrier channel. Thoroughly vacuum both track channels to ensure no residual plastic grit remains to bind the motor drive cables.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm Repair Kit (OEM #FL3Z-1651071-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-1651071-a-ford-f-150-super-duty-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-repair-kit-fl3z-1651071-a-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Install Replacement Nylon PA12 Lift Arm Assembly

Apply a liberal coating of synthetic fluoropolymer grease into the guide grooves and pivot pins of the replacement Nylon PA12 arm. Angle the forward guide block into the upper aluminum rail slot, then swing the rear pivot downward to interface with the cable drive carriage. Press downward firmly until the retention snap-tab engages the lower carrier with an audible click.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm Repair Kit (OEM #FL3Z-1651071-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-1651071-a-ford-f-150-super-duty-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-repair-kit-fl3z-1651071-a-step-4.webp)

### Step 5: Remount Glass Panel, Align Seams & Calibrate Motor

Lower the glass panel back onto the lift arms and thread the four T25 Torx screws in finger-tight. Align the front glass edge flush to 1mm below the front roofline, and the rear edge flush to 1mm above the sheet metal to eliminate wind noise, then torque screws to 4.5 Nm. Snap the accordion boots back on. Turn ignition ON, hold the sunroof TILT switch for 10 seconds until the glass cycles down and up to calibrate motor anti-pinch limits.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm Repair Kit (OEM #FL3Z-1651071-A) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-1651071-a-ford-f-150-super-duty-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-repair-kit-fl3z-1651071-a-step-5.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why did the original Ford factory lift arms crack?
**A:** The factory OEM arms were injection-molded from unreinforced POM/PBT that degrades from heat cycling and UV exposure through the glass. Once the factory track grease collects dust and thickens, the motor drive cable exerts excessive shear force on the brittle lift cam, snapping the guide pin collar.

#### Q: Why is Nylon PA12 required instead of standard PLA or PETG?
**A:** Vehicle cabins parked in direct sunlight reach interior ceiling temperatures between 65°C and 80°C. Standard PLA softens at 55°C, while PETG creeps under spring tension. Industrial Nylon PA12 maintains structural integrity past 140°C and provides natural self-lubricating surface lubricity.

#### Q: Do I need to drop the headliner to perform this repair?
**A:** No. Dealerships charge $1,800 to $2,500 because they drop the headliner to replace the entire 60001 track assembly. Our drop-in replacement arms install from the roof opening once the four T25 glass shoulder bolts and accordion bellows are removed.

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `FL3Z-16502C22-E`

- **Repair Difficulty:** Advanced
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 90 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)

- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Ford%20F150%20sunroof%20track%20repair%20kit%20lift%20arms%20FL3Z-16502C22-E&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[T25 Torx Driver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=T25%20Torx%20Driver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Extract the six glass sunroof panel retaining shoulder bolts *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Plastic Trim Bone Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Plastic%20Trim%20Bone%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Unclip flexible rubber accordion debris bellows *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Krytox GPL 205 Fluorinated Synthetic Grease](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Krytox%20GPL%20205%20Fluorinated%20Synthetic%20Grease&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Lubricate sliding guide channels with OEM specified grease *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Bellows Detachment and Moving Glass Removal

Place the sunroof in the vent position. From inside the cabin, gently pull the rubber side accordion bellows inward to release them from the lower track channel. Use a T25 Torx driver to remove the three retaining bolts on each side of the glass panel. Carefully lift the sunroof glass up and out of the vehicle.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Vista Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm (OEM #FL3Z-16502C22-E) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-16502c22-e-ford-f-150-super-duty-vista-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-fl3z-16502c22-e-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Broken Lift Arm Fragment Extraction

Locate the fractured glass lift arm inside the aluminum extrusion rail. Cycle the sunroof motor slightly if necessary to draw the drive cable slider into view. Extract the broken rear cam slider fragments and vacuum the aluminum channel clean of plastic debris.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Vista Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm (OEM #FL3Z-16502C22-E) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-16502c22-e-ford-f-150-super-duty-vista-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-fl3z-16502c22-e-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: PA12 Billet Slider Seating and Cable Pin Engagement

Coat the track slides with Krytox grease. Align the Barebones 3D reinforced Nylon PA12 lift arm into the track slot. Guide the drive cable steel drive lug directly into the slider's reinforced pivot pocket until fully engaged.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Vista Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm (OEM #FL3Z-16502C22-E) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-16502c22-e-ford-f-150-super-duty-vista-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-fl3z-16502c22-e-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Glass Re-Installation and Sunroof Module Initialization

Carefully lower the glass back into place and finger-tighten the six T25 Torx screws. Align glass gaps flush with roof sheet metal, then torque to 4.5 Nm. Perform the Ford sunroof initialization: press and hold the TILT button until the sunroof completes a full down-tilt-slide cycle.

![Original broken plastic Ford F-150 / Super Duty Vista Sunroof Track Slider Lift Arm (OEM #FL3Z-16502C22-E) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/fl3z-16502c22-e-ford-f-150-super-duty-vista-sunroof-track-slider-lift-arm-fl3z-16502c22-e-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: What is the dealer gouge on this sunroof failure?
**A:** Ford refuses to sell individual replacement plastic track arms. Dealerships require purchasing the entire panoramic frame cassette (OEM FL3Z-16502C22-E) for $1,800 to $2,400, plus 6 to 8 hours of labor dropping the headliner.

#### Q: How does Barebones 3D prevent this from snapping again?
**A:** The factory parts are molded from brittle unfilled PBT with thin wall cross-sections. Our replacement is engineered from solid Nylon PA12 with increased gusset thickness at the high-shear cable guide pin pocket.

## Technical Specifications

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[1/4 inch Nut Driver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=1%2F4%20inch%20Nut%20Driver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove top panel and front bulkhead screws *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Putty Knife](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Putty%20Knife&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Depress spring clips securing dryer top cover *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Release Top Panel Latches

Insert putty knife between front panel and top lid to release the dual internal spring retention latches.

![Original broken plastic GE / Hotpoint Clothes Dryer Front Drum Slide Bearing Glides (OEM #WE1M1067) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/we1m1067-ge-hotpoint-clothes-dryer-front-drum-slide-bearing-glides-we1m1067-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Disconnect Door Switch & Bulkhead

Unplug door safety interlock wiring harness and remove 1/4 inch screws securing front bearing bulkhead.

![Original broken plastic GE / Hotpoint Clothes Dryer Front Drum Slide Bearing Glides (OEM #WE1M1067) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/we1m1067-ge-hotpoint-clothes-dryer-front-drum-slide-bearing-glides-we1m1067-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Pry Out Worn Slide Shoes

Pop out worn Teflon/nylon slide glides from their retention slots in the upper half-circle bearing bracket.

![Original broken plastic GE / Hotpoint Clothes Dryer Front Drum Slide Bearing Glides (OEM #WE1M1067) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/we1m1067-ge-hotpoint-clothes-dryer-front-drum-slide-bearing-glides-we1m1067-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Snap In New Glides & Felt Seal

Snap new white/green slides into place and align the felt seal cushion along the outer rim.

![Original broken plastic GE / Hotpoint Clothes Dryer Front Drum Slide Bearing Glides (OEM #WE1M1067) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/we1m1067-ge-hotpoint-clothes-dryer-front-drum-slide-bearing-glides-we1m1067-step-4.webp)

### Step 5: Reassemble Bulkhead & Spin Test

Remount front panel, reconnect door sensor, lower top lid, and spin drum by hand to verify silent rotation.

![Original broken plastic GE / Hotpoint Clothes Dryer Front Drum Slide Bearing Glides (OEM #WE1M1067) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/we1m1067-ge-hotpoint-clothes-dryer-front-drum-slide-bearing-glides-we1m1067-step-5.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: What causes the loud screeching during dryer cycles?
**A:** When the plastic glides wear through, the metal drum lip grinds directly on the stationary bulkhead.

#### Q: Should I print these or buy the Amazon multipack?
**A:** Amazon sells 4-packs with replacement felt and adhesive for under $8, making commercial POD uneconomical.

# GM GMT900 HVAC Recirculation & Defrost Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #20826188)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `20826188`
- **Engineering Material:** Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 60 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [20826188.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/gm-gmt900-hvac-recirculation-defrost-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-20826188.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=GMT900%20blend%20door%20actuator%20cam%20lever%2020826188%20Silverado%20Tahoe&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[5.5mm (7/32") Flex-Head Micro-Ratchet](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=5.5mm%207%2F32%20Flex-Head%20Micro-Ratchet&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Access the recessed blind mounting screws securing the actuator above the gas pedal *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[7mm Nut Driver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=7mm%20Nut%20Driver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Drop the lower dashboard knee bolster and steering column trim *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Straight Mechanic Pick](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Straight%20Mechanic%20Pick&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Manipulate flapper door pivot to verify smooth free-hang rotation *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Knee Bolster Drop and Duct Clearance

Remove the four 7mm hex screws securing the driver-side lower dash knee bolster trim panel. Pop the metal spring clips free and set the bolster aside. Unhook the lower footwell floor air discharge duct to reveal the HVAC case side.

![Original broken plastic GM GMT900 HVAC Recirculation & Defrost Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #20826188) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/20826188-gm-gmt900-hvac-recirculation-defrost-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-20826188-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Actuator Extraction and Blind Fastener Access

Unplug the electrical connector from the defrost/mode actuator. Using a 5.5mm flex micro-ratchet, remove the two mounting screws. Pull the actuator straight off the airbox flapper shaft.

![Original broken plastic GM GMT900 HVAC Recirculation & Defrost Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #20826188) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/20826188-gm-gmt900-hvac-recirculation-defrost-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-20826188-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Sheared Cam Lever Extraction

Inspect the output drive. The original white POM cam lever cracks across the splined hub keyway, spinning freely on the shaft. Pull the broken cam off the airbox flapper door shaft with pliers and clean the splined pin.

![Original broken plastic GM GMT900 HVAC Recirculation & Defrost Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #20826188) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/20826188-gm-gmt900-hvac-recirculation-defrost-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-20826188-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: PA12 Cam Installation and GM Auto-Calibration

Press the Barebones 3D PA12 splined cam lever onto the flapper shaft until seated against the shoulder stop. Align the cam track pin with the actuator guide slot. Bolt the actuator down, reconnect the harness, pull the HVAC/ECU B fuse for 1 minute, and turn the key ON for a 90-second automated recalibration sweep.

![Original broken plastic GM GMT900 HVAC Recirculation & Defrost Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #20826188) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/20826188-gm-gmt900-hvac-recirculation-defrost-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-20826188-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why does air stay stuck blowing only out of the dashboard defrost vents?
**A:** GM's default safety fail-position for the GMT900 HVAC distribution case is full windshield defrost. When the plastic cam lever snaps, spring tension defaults the air door to the windshield.

#### Q: What is the dealer quote for this repair?
**A:** GM dealer technicians frequently claim the entire air distribution case must be replaced when the internal cam shears, quoting $1,200 to $1,600 involving complete instrument panel removal.

## Technical Specifications

- **Engineering Material:** Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Drop Lower Passenger Footwell Cover

Remove the three plastic trim retainers and swing the lower insulator panel down to expose the HVAC airbox.

![Original broken plastic GM Silverado / Tahoe / Suburban HVAC Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #89018365) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/89018365-chevrolet-gm-silverado-tahoe-suburban-hvac-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-89018365-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Unbolt Blend Door Actuator

Disconnect electrical connector and remove the two 5.5mm screws securing the blend door actuator.

![Original broken plastic GM Silverado / Tahoe / Suburban HVAC Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #89018365) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/89018365-chevrolet-gm-silverado-tahoe-suburban-hvac-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-89018365-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Inspect & Extract Split D-Bore Cam

Pull the cracked factory cam lever off the fluted blend door shaft and inspect splines for debris.

![Original broken plastic GM Silverado / Tahoe / Suburban HVAC Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #89018365) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/89018365-chevrolet-gm-silverado-tahoe-suburban-hvac-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-89018365-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Press Fit Reinforced Nylon PA12 Cam

Align keyway and press the reinforced Nylon PA12 cam firmly over the fluted blend door axle.

![Original broken plastic GM Silverado / Tahoe / Suburban HVAC Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #89018365) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/89018365-chevrolet-gm-silverado-tahoe-suburban-hvac-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-89018365-step-4.webp)

### Step 5: Reinstall Actuator & Run HVAC Re-learn

Torque screws, plug harness, pull HVAC fuse for 60s, then start engine and allow auto-calibration.

![Original broken plastic GM Silverado / Tahoe / Suburban HVAC Blend Door Actuator Cam Lever (OEM #89018365) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/89018365-chevrolet-gm-silverado-tahoe-suburban-hvac-blend-door-actuator-cam-lever-89018365-step-5.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why does the blend door continuously click?
**A:** The split D-bore slips on the fluted metal shaft; the motor senses no resistance and keeps rotating indefinitely.

#### Q: Does this require pulling the entire dashboard?
**A:** No. Dealerships book 6+ hours dashboard removal, but this lever presses on from the footwell.

## Technical Specifications

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Pop Concealment Trim Cap

Use a thin nylon pry wedge to flip open the rectangular hinge screw cover on the headliner.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee / Dodge Durango Sun Visor Pivot Support Bracket (OEM #5FS40DX9AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5fs40dx9aa-jeep-grand-cherokee-dodge-durango-sun-visor-pivot-support-bracket-5fs40dx9aa-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Extract OEM Pivot Screw

Remove the single Torx T20 fastener securing the fractured visor bracket elbow to the inner roof roof bow.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee / Dodge Durango Sun Visor Pivot Support Bracket (OEM #5FS40DX9AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5fs40dx9aa-jeep-grand-cherokee-dodge-durango-sun-visor-pivot-support-bracket-5fs40dx9aa-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Slide Off Broken Collar

Slide the split OEM plastic bracket sleeve off the visor metal pivot rod.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee / Dodge Durango Sun Visor Pivot Support Bracket (OEM #5FS40DX9AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5fs40dx9aa-jeep-grand-cherokee-dodge-durango-sun-visor-pivot-support-bracket-5fs40dx9aa-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Install Reinforced ASA Bracket

Slide the UV-resistant Automotive ASA bracket over the rod and tighten T20 screw to 2.5 Nm.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee / Dodge Durango Sun Visor Pivot Support Bracket (OEM #5FS40DX9AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5fs40dx9aa-jeep-grand-cherokee-dodge-durango-sun-visor-pivot-support-bracket-5fs40dx9aa-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why use ASA instead of PLA?
**A:** Headliners reach over 75°C in direct sun. Standard PLA deforms at 55°C, while Automotive ASA resists 100°C.

#### Q: Does this require cutting visor wiring?
**A:** No. The bracket features a precision slip-channel to clear the vanity mirror wiring harness.

# Jeep Grand Cherokee WJ Dual-Zone HVAC Blend Door Actuator Gear (OEM #5012710AA)

## Technical Specifications

- **Estimated Repair Time:** 45 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $24.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [5012710AA.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/jeep-wj-grand-cherokee-blend-door-gear-5012710aa.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Jeep%20Grand%20Cherokee%20WJ%20blend%20door%20actuator%20gear%205012710AA&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[8mm Low-Profile Ratchet Wrench](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=8mm%20Low-Profile%20Ratchet%20Wrench&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Extract blind rear actuator mounting fasteners behind dashboard sub-frame *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[T15 Torx Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=T15%20Torx%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove glove box damper hinge and lower trim screws *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Automotive Synthetic Silicone Grease](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Automotive%20Synthetic%20Silicone%20Grease&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Lubricate internal drive gear teeth and housing pivot post *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Glove Box Drop and Airbox Visual Access

Open the glove compartment door, press inward on the plastic stops on both left and right sides to disengage the travel limiters, and rotate the door completely downward. Locate the passenger-side blend door actuator mounted directly to the HVAC housing sub-frame.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee WJ Dual-Zone HVAC Blend Door Actuator Gear (OEM #5012710AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5012710aa-jeep-wj-grand-cherokee-blend-door-gear-5012710aa-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Actuator Fastener Removal and Harness Disconnect

Disconnect the 2-pin electrical connector by depressing the central tab. Use an 8mm low-profile ratchet wrench to back out the two retaining hex head bolts securing the actuator bracket to the airbox. Carefully lower the assembly straight down to clear the D-shaped door drive shaft.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee WJ Dual-Zone HVAC Blend Door Actuator Gear (OEM #5012710AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5012710aa-jeep-wj-grand-cherokee-blend-door-gear-5012710aa-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Clamshell Separation and Cracked POM Gear Extraction

Insert a precision flat blade into the four perimeter plastic locking clips along the seam of the actuator housing. Separate the top case to expose the reduction gear train. Extract the large split drive gear from the metal motor worm gear spindle, noting the internal shaft key orientation.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee WJ Dual-Zone HVAC Blend Door Actuator Gear (OEM #5012710AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5012710aa-jeep-wj-grand-cherokee-blend-door-gear-5012710aa-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: PA12 Replacement Gear Press-Fit and Re-indexing

Apply synthetic gear grease to the gear teeth. Align the Barebones 3D PA12 replacement gear bore onto the center metal drive post. Press the gear firmly into mesh with the intermediate drive pinions. Snap the clamshell cover shut until all tabs click, reinstall the actuator with the 8mm bolts, and perform the WJ dual-zone climate calibration sequence.

![Original broken plastic Jeep Grand Cherokee WJ Dual-Zone HVAC Blend Door Actuator Gear (OEM #5012710AA) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/5012710aa-jeep-wj-grand-cherokee-blend-door-gear-5012710aa-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why did the original gear split in half?
**A:** The factory Chrysler gear is molded from unfilled polyoxymethylene (POM). Constant engine bay thermal cycling embrittles the plastic, while motor stall-torque at travel endpoints induces hoop-stress fractures at the hub.

#### Q: How do I run the HVAC diagnostic calibration on the WJ?
**A:** Turn the ignition ON. Set both driver and passenger temp knobs to 75°F. Simultaneously press and hold the 'A/C' and 'Recirc' buttons while turning the left temperature control knob one click clockwise. Release both buttons.

# KitchenAid Stand Mixer Sacrificial Nylon Worm Follower Gear (OEM #WP9709231)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `WP9709231`
- **Engineering Material:** PETG Heavy Duty (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 45 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [WP9709231.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/kitchenaid-stand-mixer-sacrificial-nylon-worm-follower-gear-wp9709231.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=KitchenAid%20stand%20mixer%20worm%20follower%20gear%209709231%20food%20grade%20grease%20kit&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Flathead Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Flathead%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove chrome trim band screws *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[1/8 inch Pin Punch & Hammer](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=1%2F8%20inch%20Pin%20Punch%20Hammer&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Drive out planetary planetary bevel drive roll pin *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Food Grade Gear Grease](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Food%20Grade%20Gear%20Grease&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Pack transmission gearbox *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Remove Trim Band and Planetary Pin

Unscrew decorative chrome belly band and use 1/8 inch punch to drive out planetary lock pin.

![Original broken plastic KitchenAid Stand Mixer Sacrificial Nylon Worm Follower Gear (OEM #WP9709231) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wp9709231-kitchenaid-stand-mixer-sacrificial-nylon-worm-follower-gear-wp9709231-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Open Upper Gear Housing

Remove four housing screws and separate top motor housing to expose the transmission gear box.

![Original broken plastic KitchenAid Stand Mixer Sacrificial Nylon Worm Follower Gear (OEM #WP9709231) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wp9709231-kitchenaid-stand-mixer-sacrificial-nylon-worm-follower-gear-wp9709231-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Extract Stripped Nylon Gear

Slide off the bronze washer and lift out the stripped sacrificial nylon follower gear.

![Original broken plastic KitchenAid Stand Mixer Sacrificial Nylon Worm Follower Gear (OEM #WP9709231) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wp9709231-kitchenaid-stand-mixer-sacrificial-nylon-worm-follower-gear-wp9709231-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Repack Grease & Install New Gear

Pack gear teeth with NSF food-grade grease and seat replacement worm gear over drive tower.

![Original broken plastic KitchenAid Stand Mixer Sacrificial Nylon Worm Follower Gear (OEM #WP9709231) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wp9709231-kitchenaid-stand-mixer-sacrificial-nylon-worm-follower-gear-wp9709231-step-4.webp)

### Step 5: Realign Planetary & Fasten Casing

Rejoin housing, reinsert and stake roll pin, and run mixer on speed 1 for 2 minutes to distribute grease.

![Original broken plastic KitchenAid Stand Mixer Sacrificial Nylon Worm Follower Gear (OEM #WP9709231) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wp9709231-kitchenaid-stand-mixer-sacrificial-nylon-worm-follower-gear-wp9709231-step-5.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why is this gear intentionally made of nylon?
**A:** It acts as a mechanical fuse. If dough hooks jam, the gear strips to protect the costly electric drive motor.

#### Q: Why choose the Amazon kit over custom 3D printing?
**A:** Injection-molded replacement gears packaged with NSF food-grade grease are available on Amazon for under $10.

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why is a terminal protector essential for Makita 18V batteries?
**A:** Makita 18V LXT battery terminal blades are exposed during transport in toolboxes and trucks. Accidental shorting against loose fasteners or keys can damage the internal protection PCB or cause a fire.

- **[Torx T10 Security Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Torx%20T10%20Security%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove tamper-proof case bottom screws *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Extract Tamper-Proof T10 Screws

Remove the 4 Torx T10 security screws located in the recessed corners of the battery bottom casing.

![Original broken plastic Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM Battery Pack Locking Latch & Release Claws (OEM #48-11-1850) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/48-11-1850-milwaukee-m18-redlithium-battery-pack-locking-latch-release-claws-48-11-1850-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Separate Lower Battery Casing

Lift top collar assembly slightly to expose the dual compression spring pockets without disturbing cells.

![Original broken plastic Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM Battery Pack Locking Latch & Release Claws (OEM #48-11-1850) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/48-11-1850-milwaukee-m18-redlithium-battery-pack-locking-latch-release-claws-48-11-1850-step-2.webp)

![Original broken plastic Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM Battery Pack Locking Latch & Release Claws (OEM #48-11-1850) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/48-11-1850-milwaukee-m18-redlithium-battery-pack-locking-latch-release-claws-48-11-1850-step-3.webp)

Slide new solid Nylon PA12 latches into the guide rails and seat return springs onto alignment studs.

![Original broken plastic Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM Battery Pack Locking Latch & Release Claws (OEM #48-11-1850) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/48-11-1850-milwaukee-m18-redlithium-battery-pack-locking-latch-release-claws-48-11-1850-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Can I replace latches without touching the internal lithium cells?
**A:** Yes. The latches reside in an isolated side perimeter channel; internal cell connections remain untouched.

#### Q: Why is Nylon PA12 necessary for power tool latches?
**A:** Power tools endure repeated high-vibration shocks and job site drops that will instantly fracture standard PLA or resin.

# Subaru HVAC Blend Door Actuator Split Gear (OEM #72131-FG000)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `72131-FG000`
- **Engineering Material:** Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 45 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [72131-FG000.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/subaru-blend-door-actuator-gear-72131-fg000.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Subaru%20HVAC%20Blend%20Door%20Actuator%20Split%20Gear%20OEM%2072131-FG000&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Phillips #2 Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Phillips%20%232%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Glove box trim screws *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Plastic Trim Pry Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Plastic%20Trim%20Pry%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Lower dash kick panel clips *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[7mm Hex Socket & Driver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=7mm%20Hex%20Socket%20Driver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Actuator motor mounting bolts *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[White Lithium Grease](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=White%20Lithium%20Grease&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Gear teeth lubrication *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Lower Dash & Glovebox Removal

Depress the side damper clips inside the passenger glovebox. Unscrew the two lower pivot screws using a #2 Phillips screwdriver. Gently pull downward to release the assembly without stressing the nylon hinges.

> **Pro Tip:** Place screws into an organizer tray to avoid mixing up trim screws with chassis ground screws.

![Original broken plastic Subaru HVAC Blend Door Actuator Split Gear (OEM #72131-FG000) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/72131-fg000-subaru-blend-door-actuator-gear-72131-fg000-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Locate HVAC Blend Door Actuator

Look to the left of the cabin air filter cavity on the HVAC climate box. You will see a small black plastic servo motor box secured by three 7mm hex bolts.

> **Caution:** Do not force the blend door linkage arm by hand while the motor is plugged in to avoid stripping the interior potentiometer.

![Original broken plastic Subaru HVAC Blend Door Actuator Split Gear (OEM #72131-FG000) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/72131-fg000-subaru-blend-door-actuator-gear-72131-fg000-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Unclip Wire Harness & Extract Actuator

Depress the locking tab on the 5-pin wiring connector and extract it. Remove the three 7mm bolts and lift the actuator motor straight outward from the HVAC casing.

![Original broken plastic Subaru HVAC Blend Door Actuator Split Gear (OEM #72131-FG000) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/72131-fg000-subaru-blend-door-actuator-gear-72131-fg000-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Open Actuator Case & Swap Split Gear

Pry the four perimeter casing clips with a flat tool. The OEM white nylon spur gear will likely show a hairline fracture along the D-bore shaft. Clean out old dried grease, apply fresh white lithium grease, and press the new Barebones 3D PA12 Nylon gear onto the metal drive shaft.

> **Pro Tip:** Nylon PA12 provides self-lubricating qualities and higher shear strength than standard injection-molded POM.

![Original broken plastic Subaru HVAC Blend Door Actuator Split Gear (OEM #72131-FG000) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/72131-fg000-subaru-blend-door-actuator-gear-72131-fg000-step-4.webp)

### Step 5: Re-indexing & Functional Climate Test

Snap the casing together, re-seat onto the HVAC box spline, reconnect the 5-pin plug, and turn vehicle ignition to ON. Cycle cabin temperature from Cold (60°F) to Hot (85°F) to verify smooth, quiet flap travel before reinstalling the glovebox.

![Original broken plastic Subaru HVAC Blend Door Actuator Split Gear (OEM #72131-FG000) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/72131-fg000-subaru-blend-door-actuator-gear-72131-fg000-step-5.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why does the OEM Subaru gear fail?
**A:** The OEM gear was molded from brittle unreinforced POM with an undersized wall thickness around the drive D-flat. Cyclic thermal expansion between winter heating and summer A/C causes radial hoop stress cracking.

#### Q: Why is Nylon PA12 specified instead of PLA or PETG?
**A:** Automotive under-dash temperatures can exceed 70°C in direct summer sunlight. PLA deforms at 55°C. PA12 Nylon has a heat deflection temperature of over 110°C, high impact resistance, and natural lubricity.

#### Q: Does this part require special slicer tolerances?
**A:** The free STL is engineered with a +0.15mm printer tolerance compensation for FDM. If printing on a Bambu or Prusa, slice at 0.12mm layer height and 100% infill.

![Original broken plastic Subaru Impreza / Forester / Crosstrek Sun Visor Pivot Clip Bracket (OEM #92011SC022LO) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/92011sc022lo-subaru-impreza-forester-crosstrek-sun-visor-clip-92011sc022lo-step-1.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why do Subaru visor clips snap constantly?
**A:** Subaru's OEM plastic contains zero UV stabilizers. Sitting directly behind the windshield greenhouse generates interior cabin soak temperatures above 65°C, causing the plastic jaw tabs to snap on simple visor pulls.

#### Q: Can this be printed in PLA?
**A:** Never use PLA inside an automobile cabin. PLA softens at 55°C (131°F) and will deform within 48 hours of summer parking. Automotive ASA maintains dimensional stability past 95°C.
