# Technics SL-1200 / SL-1210 MK2 Turntable Dust Cover Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #SFUMM02N04)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `SFUMM02N04`
- **Engineering Material:** Automotive ASA (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 20 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $26.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [SFUMM02N04.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/technics-sl-1200-sl-1210-mk2-dust-cover-hinge-bracket-sfumm02n04.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Technics%20SL-1200%20SL-1210%20dust%20cover%20hinge%20bracket%20SFUMM02N04&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[JIS #2 Screwdriver (or PH2)](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=JIS%20%232%20Screwdriver%20or%20PH2&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Back out chassis hinge pocket screws without stripping Japanese Industrial Standard heads *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Needle-Nose Pliers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Needle-Nose%20Pliers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Retain and seat the heavy internal steel hinge torsion spring *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Dust Cover Separation and Remnant Removal

Lift the acrylic dust cover vertically off the chassis. Back out the two JIS #2 screws securing the broken die-cast/plastic lower hinge receiver bracket from the rear aluminum plinth.

![Original broken plastic Technics SL-1200 / SL-1210 MK2 Turntable Dust Cover Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #SFUMM02N04) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/sfumm02n04-technics-sl-1200-sl-1210-mk2-dust-cover-hinge-bracket-sfumm02n04-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Torsion Spring Pin Transfer

Use needle-nose pliers to extract the internal steel pivot pin and spring from the damaged original housing. Inspect the spring tangs for corrosion or fatigue bending, and wipe clean.

![Original broken plastic Technics SL-1200 / SL-1210 MK2 Turntable Dust Cover Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #SFUMM02N04) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/sfumm02n04-technics-sl-1200-sl-1210-mk2-dust-cover-hinge-bracket-sfumm02n04-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: ASA Bracket Base Installation

Position the Barebones 3D UV-resistant ASA replacement hinge bracket into the rear plinth recess. Secure the base using the factory metric M3/M4 JIS screws, making sure the mount is seated squarely against the plinth.

![Original broken plastic Technics SL-1200 / SL-1210 MK2 Turntable Dust Cover Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #SFUMM02N04) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/sfumm02n04-technics-sl-1200-sl-1210-mk2-dust-cover-hinge-bracket-sfumm02n04-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Acrylic Cover Insertion and Hinge Tension Check

Load the steel torsion spring into the ASA bracket socket and insert the hinge slide tab. Slide the acrylic dust cover tongue straight down into the receiver until it seats. Test open/close holding tension at a 45-degree angle.

![Original broken plastic Technics SL-1200 / SL-1210 MK2 Turntable Dust Cover Hinge Repair Bracket (OEM #SFUMM02N04) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/sfumm02n04-technics-sl-1200-sl-1210-mk2-dust-cover-hinge-bracket-sfumm02n04-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why did Panasonic discontinue this part?
**A:** Panasonic phased out legacy SL-1200MK2 component spares in the early 2010s. OEM new-old-stock pairs now trade on vintage Hi-Fi marketplaces for over $100.

#### Q: Why is ASA used instead of standard black ABS?
**A:** Automotive ASA delivers the high impact strength of ABS but contains an acrylate elastomer that provides total immunity to UV yellowing and solar degradation from room sunlight.

# Toyota Tacoma Heater Control Valve Arm (OEM #87240-04020)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `87240-04020`
- **Engineering Material:** High-Temp Nylon PA12 (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Moderate
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 35 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [87240-04020.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/toyota-toyota-tacoma-heater-control-valve-arm-87240-04020.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Toyota%20Tacoma%20Heater%20Control%20Valve%20Arm%20OEM%2087240-04020&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[10mm Socket Wrench](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=10mm%20Socket%20Wrench&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Firewall bracket mounting bolts *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Hose Pinch Pliers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Hose%20Pinch%20Pliers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Clamp heater core coolant hoses *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Needle-Nose Pliers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Needle-Nose%20Pliers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Cable retention spring clip *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Coolant Hose Clamping

Clamp the inlet and outlet 5/8 inch coolant lines near the firewall to avoid draining the engine cooling system.

> **Caution:** Ensure engine is cold before handling pressurized cooling hoses.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tacoma Heater Control Valve Arm (OEM #87240-04020) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed High-Temp Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/87240-04020-toyota-toyota-tacoma-heater-control-valve-arm-87240-04020-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Bowden Cable Release

Pry open the cable retention clip with needle nose pliers and slide the loop off the fractured OEM actuator arm pin.

> **Pro Tip:** Mark cable jacket position with paint marker for zero-drift alignment.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tacoma Heater Control Valve Arm (OEM #87240-04020) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed High-Temp Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/87240-04020-toyota-toyota-tacoma-heater-control-valve-arm-87240-04020-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Valve Spindle Inspection

Wipe the brass valve spindle clean with rubbing alcohol. Confirm free 90-degree rotary movement without binding.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tacoma Heater Control Valve Arm (OEM #87240-04020) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed High-Temp Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/87240-04020-toyota-toyota-tacoma-heater-control-valve-arm-87240-04020-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Reproduction Arm Installation

Press-fit the reinforced Nylon PA12 replacement arm over the keyed brass shaft until it bottoms flush against the collar.

> **Pro Tip:** The calibrated +0.15mm printer tolerance guarantees a snug press-fit without wobble.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tacoma Heater Control Valve Arm (OEM #87240-04020) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed High-Temp Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/87240-04020-toyota-toyota-tacoma-heater-control-valve-arm-87240-04020-step-4.webp)

### Step 5: Operational Cable Verification

Cycle temperature selector knob inside the cab across full Cold-to-Hot range. Confirm full 90-degree valve sweep.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tacoma Heater Control Valve Arm (OEM #87240-04020) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed High-Temp Nylon PA12 reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/87240-04020-toyota-toyota-tacoma-heater-control-valve-arm-87240-04020-step-5.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why choose this reinforced 3D printed High-Temp Nylon PA12 reproduction over brittle factory plastic?
**A:** Factory OEM plastic degrades from thermal stress and UV fatigue. Our reproduction is 100% solid filled in industrial-grade High-Temp Nylon PA12 with calibrated tolerances (+0.15mm) to permanently eliminate brittle failure points.

#### Q: How does the +0.15mm printer tolerance compensation affect installation?
**A:** Internal bores and snap channels are widened by exactly +0.15mm to eliminate elephant-foot seam binding, allowing a direct hand press-fit without filing or drilling.

# Toyota Tundra / Sequoia Dash AC Air Vent Louver Tab (OEM #55670-0C010)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `55670-0C010`
- **Engineering Material:** Automotive ASA (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 15 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** $15.00 USD (Printed on-demand in 48h via Slant 3D)
- **Direct STL Download:** [55670-0C010.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/toyota-tundra-air-vent-louver-tab-55670-0c010.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Toyota%20Tundra%20%2F%20Sequoia%20Dash%20AC%20Air%20Vent%20Louver%20Tab%20OEM%2055670-0C010&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Nylon Dash Pry Tool](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Nylon%20Dash%20Pry%20Tool&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Bezel perimeter release *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Needle-Nose Pliers](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Needle-Nose%20Pliers&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Remove broken rear linkage pin *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Protect Dash and Pry Vent Bezel

Apply painter tape along the dashboard perimeter to protect the soft vinyl. Insert a nylon pry tool at the 3 o clock position and pop the retaining spring tabs outward.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tundra / Sequoia Dash AC Air Vent Louver Tab (OEM #55670-0C010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/55670-0c010-toyota-tundra-air-vent-louver-tab-55670-0c010-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Extract Broken Linkage Remnants

Fish out the broken OEM plastic fingers from inside the horizontal vent slat. Use needle-nose pliers to make sure the internal vertical sync-bar is unblocked.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tundra / Sequoia Dash AC Air Vent Louver Tab (OEM #55670-0C010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/55670-0c010-toyota-tundra-air-vent-louver-tab-55670-0c010-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Slide New ASA Tab Over Center Slat

Position the front grip tab over the central horizontal vane, then press the rear fork into the vertical sync rod until it snaps firmly into the retention notch.

> **Pro Tip:** ASA provides exceptional UV and thermal stability under direct sun-baked windshield environments.

![Original broken plastic Toyota Tundra / Sequoia Dash AC Air Vent Louver Tab (OEM #55670-0C010) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Automotive ASA reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/55670-0c010-toyota-tundra-air-vent-louver-tab-55670-0c010-step-3.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Does Toyota sell this tab separately?
**A:** No. Toyota dealerships only sell the entire dashboard register assembly (OEM #55670-0C010) which retails for upwards of $260.00.

#### Q: Will this melt in the hot summer sun?
**A:** No. It is printed in ASA (Acrylonitrile Styrene Acrylate), which withstands temperatures up to 100°C without sagging and contains built-in UV stabilizers.

# Vintage Pioneer PL-12D Tonearm Anti-Skate Weight Guide Arm (OEM #WA-104)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `WA-104`
- **Engineering Material:** PETG (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Easy
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 15 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only (Commercial reproduction restricted by author license)
- **Direct STL Download:** [WA-104.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/pioneer-turntable-anti-skate-arm-wa-104.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Vintage%20Pioneer%20PL-12D%20Tonearm%20Anti-Skate%20Weight%20Guide%20Arm%20OEM%20WA-104&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[0.050in Hex Allen Key](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=0.050in%20Hex%20Allen%20Key&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Gimbal set screw *(Search on Amazon)*
- **[Nylon Monofilament Line](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Nylon%20Monofilament%20Line&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Anti-skate weight string *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Inspect Tonearm Pivot Housing

Locate the small horizontal hole at the rear right of the tonearm gimbal bearing. Inspect for remnants of the snapped plastic guide arm.

![Original broken plastic Vintage Pioneer PL-12D Tonearm Anti-Skate Weight Guide Arm (OEM #WA-104) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wa-104-pioneer-turntable-anti-skate-arm-wa-104-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Install Replacement Guide Wire Arm

Insert the printed guide wire stem into the gimbal receiver. Tighten the side grub screw lightly with an Allen key until snug.

![Original broken plastic Vintage Pioneer PL-12D Tonearm Anti-Skate Weight Guide Arm (OEM #WA-104) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wa-104-pioneer-turntable-anti-skate-arm-wa-104-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Re-hang Weight and Calibrate Skating Force

Thread monofilament line through the notched guide wire and suspend the brass anti-skate weight according to your cartridge tracking force (typically notch 2 for 1.5g tracking force).

![Original broken plastic Vintage Pioneer PL-12D Tonearm Anti-Skate Weight Guide Arm (OEM #WA-104) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wa-104-pioneer-turntable-anti-skate-arm-wa-104-step-3.webp)

- **[Dish Soap (few drops)](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Dish%20Soap%20few%20drops&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Axle lubrication during press-fit *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Extract Lower Dishwasher Rack

Open the dishwasher door fully, roll the lower rack out, and lift it clear of the tub rails. Place it inverted on a clean kitchen towel.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool / KitchenAid Dishwasher Lower Rack Wheel & Axle Assembly (OEM #W10195416) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Food-Safe PETG reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/w10195416-whirlpool-dishwasher-rack-wheel-w10195416-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Inspect and Remove Broken Snap Retainer

Examine the wheel bracket. The OEM retention tab becomes chalky and brittle from caustic detergent. Gently slide a flat screwdriver behind the tab and push toward the wire frame to unclip.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool / KitchenAid Dishwasher Lower Rack Wheel & Axle Assembly (OEM #W10195416) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Food-Safe PETG reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/w10195416-whirlpool-dishwasher-rack-wheel-w10195416-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: Clean Wire Frame Mounting Node

Wipe any calcium or mineral scale off the stainless steel wire rack node with white vinegar or a scouring pad to ensure smooth wheel rotation.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool / KitchenAid Dishwasher Lower Rack Wheel & Axle Assembly (OEM #W10195416) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Food-Safe PETG reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/w10195416-whirlpool-dishwasher-rack-wheel-w10195416-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Snap-fit Heavy-Duty Replacement Assembly

Align the inner axle channel with the rack wire, press firmly until an audible click confirms engagement, then slide the wheel onto the hub. Verify free spinning without wobble.

> **Pro Tip:** Our replacement features a 40% thicker structural flange to eliminate the common breakage at the detergent boundary layer.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool / KitchenAid Dishwasher Lower Rack Wheel & Axle Assembly (OEM #W10195416) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed Food-Safe PETG reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/w10195416-whirlpool-dishwasher-rack-wheel-w10195416-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Can this part withstand the 85°C Sani-Rinse cycle?
**A:** Yes. Our reproduction part is printed from high-temp, detergent-resistant PETG with a glass transition temperature rated safely above dishwasher hot-water cycles.

#### Q: Are the chemicals in 3D prints safe for dishwashers?
**A:** Our PETG is virgin food-contact grade polymer and is placed on the lower rack exterior away from food contact surfaces.

# Whirlpool Dishwasher Lower Dishrack Roller Wheel & Axle Clip (OEM #WPW10195417)

## Technical Specifications
- **Primary OEM Part #:** `WPW10195417`
- **Engineering Material:** PETG Heavy Duty (100% solid infill, calibrated printer compensation)
- **Repair Difficulty:** Beginner
- **Estimated Repair Time:** 5 mins
- **Commercial Purchase:** Digital STL Only / Commodity Multi-Pack on Amazon: [Search Amazon Catalog](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Whirlpool%20dishwasher%20lower%20dishrack%20wheels%208%20pack%20WPW10195417&tag=barebones3dco-20) (Cheaper than custom 3D printing)
- **Direct STL Download:** [WPW10195417.stl](https://barebones3d.com/assets/stl/whirlpool-dishwasher-lower-dishrack-roller-wheel-axle-clip-wpw10195417.stl)
- **Amazon OEM & Hardware Search:** [Check Price & Availability on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Whirlpool%20dishwasher%20lower%20dishrack%20wheels%208%20pack%20WPW10195417&tag=barebones3dco-20)

## Required Tools & Supplies
- **[Flat Blade Pocket Screwdriver](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Flat%20Blade%20Pocket%20Screwdriver&tag=barebones3dco-20)**: Depress the center snap barb on the brittle wire retention clip *(Search on Amazon)*

## Step-by-Step Installation Procedure
### Step 1: Dishtray Extraction and Wheel Inspection

Pull the lower dishrack completely out of the wash tub and place it inverted on a clean counter. Inspect the eight roller positions to locate melted, flat-spotted, or missing wheels.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool Dishwasher Lower Dishrack Roller Wheel & Axle Clip (OEM #WPW10195417) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wpw10195417-whirlpool-dishwasher-lower-dishrack-roller-wheel-axle-clip-wpw10195417-step-1.webp)

### Step 2: Damaged Wheel Clip Separation

Insert the flathead screwdriver blade beneath the central locking tang of the plastic wheel axle bracket. Pry slightly outward while pushing the wheel assembly off the steel wire frame.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool Dishwasher Lower Dishrack Roller Wheel & Axle Clip (OEM #WPW10195417) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wpw10195417-whirlpool-dishwasher-lower-dishrack-roller-wheel-axle-clip-wpw10195417-step-2.webp)

### Step 3: New Roller Alignment over Wire Frame

Align the replacement wheel assembly with the dual wire rungs. The axle notch must straddle the lower wire while the upper locking clip hooks over the top stabilizing rail.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool Dishwasher Lower Dishrack Roller Wheel & Axle Clip (OEM #WPW10195417) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wpw10195417-whirlpool-dishwasher-lower-dishrack-roller-wheel-axle-clip-wpw10195417-step-3.webp)

### Step 4: Snap-Lock Engagement and Tub Glide Test

Press inward firmly with your thumb on the wheel axle until the retention barb clicks over the wire. Return the rack to the dishwasher tub and roll it in and out to ensure smooth, unhindered tracking over the tub door bridge.

![Original broken plastic Whirlpool Dishwasher Lower Dishrack Roller Wheel & Axle Clip (OEM #WPW10195417) shown side-by-side with reinforced 3D printed PETG Heavy Duty reproduction.](https://barebones3d.com/assets/parts/wpw10195417-whirlpool-dishwasher-lower-dishrack-roller-wheel-axle-clip-wpw10195417-step-4.webp)

## Frequently Asked Questions
#### Q: Why is this part listed as affiliate-only instead of print-on-demand?
**A:** OEM appliance counters charge $35 per single roller wheel. However, high-grade injection-molded 8-packs are widely available on Amazon for under $12. Print-on-demand unit economics cannot compete with $1.50/wheel pricing, so we direct owners to mass-market multipacks via affiliate routing while providing free STL files for DIY makers.

#### Q: Can I print this part on my home printer?
**A:** Yes, but you must use PETG, ABS, or Nylon. PLA will soften, warp, and release micro-plastics during the dishwasher's 65°C (150°F) heated wash and sanitize dry cycles.
